policy.future_paths: Candidate partitions. Freeze exact interfaces and write paths in DOC_CONTRACT and obtain APPROVAL before any code dispatch.
policy.runtime_binding: Every dispatch binds base SHA, accepted dependency SHAs, approval digest, input hashes, isolated worktree and exclusive write lease. PLANNED nodes are not started agents.
policy.reviewer_reports: Reviewers do not modify the repository. Orchestrator stores their returned verdicts in the ledger with a real agent ID.
policy.accepted_dependency: All dependencies must be ACCEPTED at the required artifact revision; WORKFLOW may accept factual scans without claiming Terra implementation review.
policy.fixes: Fresh bounded Luna max fixer and independent re-review; max 3 unsuccessful cycles. Code defects never return to orchestrator for editing.
policy.invalidation: Changed dependency SHA or contract digest invalidates affected descendants and prior review acceptance.
policy.readiness: All dependencies accepted, approval present for code, exact paths resolved, nonoverlapping leases, no unmet upstream gate, capacity available.
policy.code_selection: APPROVAL must explicitly select or exclude missing desktop history/playback/recording-Q&A capabilities. Backend non-applicability is reviewable evidence, not a default skip or completed feature.
shared_lease_transfers: .github/workflows/ci.yml: BASELINE -> INTEGRATE only after accepted review and lease release.
src/tauri.ts: SHARED_CONTRACT -> INTEGRATE only after shared and UI reviews and lease release.
src-tauri/src/lib.rs and src-tauri/src/meeting_intel.rs: BACKEND_RECORDING only if explicitly approved; remain forbidden otherwise.
policy.control_plane_revision: After proposal snapshot, record reason/time/changed fields/old-new digests and invalidated descendants for any orchestrator manifest revision. Editing approval metadata never grants approval.

candidate_lease_amendments.authority: Proposed by DOC_CONTRACT, not authorized for code until feature APPROVAL. Documentation review must check exact set.

policy.review_readiness: Read-only review nodes consume complete hash-pinned REVIEW handoffs with released write leases, or already ACCEPTED dependencies. They do not require their own future verdict first. Accepted review promotes corresponding worker inputs. Downstream write nodes still require ACCEPTED gates and explicit feature approval.
